conclusion: Over F3, no two live same-colour-diagonal graphs can jointly satisfy the pairconstant, 00000101, and 01010101 packet; hence there is no three-colour diagonal solution to this packet.
proof: For X_d*C_c=0 and perm(M^d_ij)=-1, the zero set of C_c in each 2x2 block must contain a diagonal or antidiagonal pair. Only 168 live signatures pass this six-block test, and every one has |supp Q|=10. The 4+4 equations require supp(Q_c) disjoint from complement(supp(Q_d)); two size-10 subsets of a 16-set cannot be disjoint.
scope: This is an exact special-fibre theorem over F3, not yet a characteristic-zero theorem. It also assumes all cross-colour cells vanish, so literal full-row residual tails are absent.
